record.context_brief: closed-form Ricci-flat metrics on quartic surfaces
record.original_question: Find an explicit closed-form expression for a Ricci-flat metric on a quartic surface.

evidence.quote: Question 3.1. Find the explicit form of a Ricci-flat metric on a quartic surface in a closed form.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $X \subset \mathbb{CP}^3$ be a smooth quartic surface, i.e. the zero locus of a homogeneous polynomial of degree 4 in four complex variables that is nonsingular as a complex projective variety. Such an $X$ is a K3 surface: it is simply connected, has trivial canonical bundle $K_X \cong \mathcal{O}_X$, and admits a nowhere-vanishing holomorphic 2-form. By Yau's theorem, in every Kähler class on $X$ there exists a unique Ricci-flat Kähler metric $g$ (a Calabi–Yau metric), characterized by $\mathrm{Ric}(g) = 0$.

Problem. Exhibit, for some smooth quartic surface $X \subset \mathbb{CP}^3$ and some Kähler class $[\omega] \in H^{1,1}(X,\mathbb{R})$, an explicit closed-form expression (in terms of elementary, algebraic, or classical special functions of the ambient projective coordinates) for the Kähler potential, or equivalently the Kähler form $\omega$, of a Ricci-flat Kähler metric on $X$ representing $[\omega]$.
artifact.category_tag: Ricci-flat Kähler metrics on K3 surfaces
artifact.status_search_result: No explicit closed-form Ricci-flat (Calabi–Yau) metric on a smooth quartic K3 surface is known. Yau's theorem guarantees existence and uniqueness in each Kähler class, but only numerical approximations (e.g., Headrick–Wiseman and subsequent works) and asymptotic constructions near degenerations (e.g., near the Kummer/orbifold limit) are available. The problem of finding an explicit closed-form expression remains open as of 2026.

status_evidence.title: Numerical Ricci-flat metrics on K3
status_evidence.snippet: Numerical algorithms for solving the Einstein equation on Calabi-Yau manifolds; no explicit closed-form metrics are produced.
status_evidence.claim: Only numerical, not closed-form, Ricci-flat metrics on K3 are known.

status_evidence.title: A Calabi-Yau Metric on the Kummer Surface
status_evidence.snippet: Constructions near orbifold/Kummer degenerations give approximate or asymptotic Calabi–Yau metrics, not explicit closed forms on a smooth quartic.
status_evidence.claim: Recent progress is asymptotic/approximate near degenerations, not closed-form on quartics.

status_evidence.title: Ricci-flat metrics and dynamics on K3 surfaces
status_evidence.snippet: Survey discusses existence via Yau's theorem and lack of explicit formulas for K3 Ricci-flat metrics.
status_evidence.claim: Explicit formulas for Ricci-flat metrics on K3 surfaces are not known.
